name: The most scenic drives in america, newly revised and updated : 120 spectacular road trips: 9781606523582
description: The all-in-one trip planner and travel guide--now totally revised and updated--will steer travelers down the most scenic road every time. From Florida's Road to Flamingo to Hawaii's Oahu Coastal Loop, each featured road trip is pictured in stunning full color and described in vivid text, keyed to an easy-to-follow newly revised map.
